title: Honor approval for direct M8 Skill Agent execution
goal: Make direct M8 Skill Agent and chat-team execution honor an explicit approval gate before invoking a Skill executor when policy requires approval.
context: The canonical M6 adapter carries prior approval into SkillRuntime, but SkillAgentOrchestrator only accepts PolicyEvaluating. Its direct M8 APIs therefore fail closed for requiresApproval even when M8CompositionRoot has an ApprovalGate configured.
forbidden_changes: Do not allow an executor to run after policy denial, missing approval gate, approval rejection, or cancellation.
Do not bypass ModuleRuntime's own policy or approval boundary for module-backed Skills.
Do not change the canonical M6 approval flow or claim direct Skill Agent calls emit M6 audit events.
Do not accept approval for a different Skill ID or capabilities than the selected Skill requires.
acceptance_criteria: M8 SkillAgentOrchestrator receives the configured ApprovalGate from composition.
A requiresApproval decision requests approval with the selected typed Skill ID and effective capabilities.
Approved direct Skill execution uses one scoped authorization decision and verifies output through the same executor instance.
Rejected, missing, failed, or cancelled approval produces no executor invocation and no verified result.
Module-backed Skills continue to pass through ModuleRuntime policy and approval independently.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
The explicit M8 executeSkill API uses the same approval-aware Agent scope boundary as runSkillAgent.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Keep approval at the Skill boundary explicit, scope the post-approval policy wrapper to the selected Skill and effective capabilities, and leave ModuleRuntime authorization unchanged.
